summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) filed a Form 6-K announcing TSX approval of a new normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase for cancellation up to 30 million common shares (~3.3% of shares outstanding), replacing a completed prior NCIB. Aggregate repurchases represent ~5.5% of public float. Purchases at market price commence on or after June 8, 2026, within daily volume limits (max 673,084 shares), and conclude by June 7, 2027. An automatic share purchase plan allows trading during blackouts. CIBC Capital Markets acts as designated broker. Prior NCIB bought 20M shares at avg ~C$129.68 for C$2.6B.
